notes: Inbound SMB lead from B2B SaaS — Inserted into AE queue after self-serve signup. Product: in-app assistant embedded in CRM-like dashboard used by account managers. Primary ask: streaming responses that feel instantaneous in UI (goal: sub-200ms perceived latency for short answers). Current setup: prototype using vanilla open endpoint + frontend websocket; devs reported p50 ~220ms and spikes to ~280ms under simulated load. Team is cost-conscious (early-stage, seed) but willing to pay for consistent UX; they prefer hosted API to avoid infra ops.
detailed_requirements: - Workload: high interactivity chat (short-turn conversations), avg response length 12-40 tokens; heavy emphasis on first-token latency and steady streaming. - Throughput: 20 concurrent active users for initial POC, plan to scale 5x in 6 months. - Model preferences: prefer smaller low-latency models for mainline, fallback to stronger model for complex queries. - Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to cheaper/compatible variant when capacity constrained. - Observability: token-level latency and error traces per request. - Security: SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs for admin actions, data retention controls for chat transcripts.
